title: A paid shop session that does not match its order's amount fails loudly instead of leaving the order pending in silence

source.ref: Meta scan eight (2026-10-12), commerce review of #3337 (LIVE-882).

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-12. THE CONSEQUENCE: LIVE-882 made the pending-to-paid flip and the replay read match on amount_cents and currency as well as the session. When a paid session's amount or currency differed from the order (any Stripe-side change such as Adaptive Pricing, which reports the buyer's currency), both reads returned nothing, the function returned normally, the webhook acked 200 and Stripe never redelivered: a charged buyer, an order pending forever, no log line. No in-app path makes them differ today. THE FIX: when neither read matches, the settle reads the session's pending rows; if one exists it logs the expected and paid amounts and throws, so Stripe redelivers and the failure is visible. Test in checkout.test.ts.

verify.cmd: node -e "const s=require('fs').readFileSync('lib/commerce/checkout.ts','utf8');if(!/paid amount or currency does not match the pending order/.test(s)){console.error('SCAN-823: a paid session with a mismatched amount acks with the order still pending');process.exit(1)}"
